A letter for

ChaChad

Hiii Bebee,

I don't really have a big fancy opening for this. I just wanted to sit down and write everything I've been feeling lately, kasi you deserve to hear it, not just feel it. I know I don't always have the right words when I'm talking to you, and sometimes I feel like no matter how much I say "I love you," it still doesn't fully explain how much you mean to me. So I'm writing this instead. This is probably going to be long, so get comfy, because I have a lot to say, and honestly, I don't think I'll ever run out of things to say about you. There are so many thoughts about you that stay in my head every day, and I just want you to know them.

I love the little things about us the most. The way you check up on me kahit pagod ka na. The way you remember something I mentioned once in passing, like it actually mattered to you. The random "kumain ka na?" texts, the "ingat ka" before I leave the house, the way you ask if I've gotten home safely, and even the little reminders that you care. They're such simple things, but they mean so much more than you probably realize. Sometimes it's the smallest things you do that make me stop and think, "Grabe, I really have someone who cares about me this much." I notice those things, bebe. I notice more than I probably say.

You have no idea how much comfort you bring me. On days when everything feels like too much, when my head is loud and my energy is low, just talking to you somehow makes everything feel a little lighter. You don't always have to fix anything. You don't need to have the perfect advice or the perfect words. Sometimes you just being there is already enough. There's something about your presence that makes me feel safe, and that's something I don't take for granted. When the world feels overwhelming, knowing that I have you makes me feel like I have somewhere to breathe and somewhere to rest.

I also love that I don't have to pretend around you. I can be tired, weird, annoying, clingy, emotional, quiet, or completely random, and somehow you still stay. I don't have to constantly worry about being perfect or acting a certain way just so you'll continue to love me. I can just be myself, and you still look at me the same way. That kind of comfort and safety is rare, bebe. Being loved when I'm at my best is one thing, but being accepted even when I'm not at my best means so much more to me. Thank you for letting me be human around you.

We've been through a lot of ups and downs, and I know some days are harder than others. We've had moments where things weren't easy, moments where emotions got heavy, and moments where we probably didn't understand each other the way we wanted to. But even through all of that, you're still the person I want next to me. I don't want someone who is only there when everything is perfect. I want someone who stays when things get messy too, and that's you. You're not someone I simply have to deal with; you're someone I genuinely want on my team. I want us to keep learning how to understand each other, communicate better, and grow together.

You honestly make me want to become a better person. Not because you force me to or because I feel like I have to change everything about myself, but because loving you makes me want to grow. I want to become someone who can love you better, understand you better, support you better, and make you feel as loved as you make me feel. I notice how hard you try, even when things don't go your way. I notice how you still show up when you're tired, how you care for people, and how much effort you put into the things that matter to you. You probably don't realize how inspiring that is to me, but it is. I learn from you more than you know.

Even the boring days with you don't really feel boring. I love the idea of simply existing with you. Sitting together, scrolling on our phones, doing our own things, talking about random nonsense, being quiet for a while, or just enjoying each other's presence. I don't need grand gestures every day. I don't need everything to be exciting all the time. Sometimes, all I want is you beside me. There's something so comforting about knowing that I can spend an ordinary day with you and still feel completely happy. I think that's one of the things that makes what we have feel real to me.

I think about our future a lot, bebe, and I think about it in the sweetest and calmest way. Not in a rushed or scary way, but in a quiet "I can't wait" kind of way. I think about all the memories we haven't made yet, all the inside jokes we haven't created, all the places we haven't gone to, all the random conversations we'll have, and all the little moments that we'll probably forget someday but still mean everything while we're living them. I want more birthdays, more celebrations, more trips, more late-night talks, more mornings, more ordinary days, more memories, and just more of us. Whenever I imagine the future and you're part of it, I feel excited instead of afraid, and I think that says a lot about how right this feels to me.

I want you to know that I'm here for you too. If you're ever having a hard day and you read this, I hope you remember that you don't have to carry everything alone. You don't always have to be strong around me. You don't have to pretend you're okay when you're not. You can tell me when you're tired, when you're frustrated, when you're scared, or when you just need someone to sit with you. I'm here, not only when it's convenient, not only when everything is happy, but during the difficult days too. I want to be someone you can lean on just as much as I lean on you. Whatever life throws at us, I want you to know that you have me.

Most of all, I love you because choosing you keeps making sense to me. I love you on the easy days, but I also love you on the difficult ones. I love the person you are now, and I love watching you grow into the person you're becoming. I love your heart, your effort, your patience, your little habits, your imperfections, and even the things you probably don't like about yourself. I don't expect us to be perfect, because I don't think love is about being perfect. I think it's about continuing to choose each other, continuing to understand each other, and continuing to show up. And if I had to choose again and again, I'd still choose you. Today, tomorrow, on the good days, on the bad days, and on all the ordinary days in between. I love you so much, bebe. More than I can properly put into words. Thank you for being you, for being part of my life, and for giving me a kind of love that feels like home. Always remember that no matter what happens, there will always be a part of me that is grateful that I got to love you.

Some memories deserve a little place to live forever.
our little universe

Moments I never want to forget ♡

♡

Forever yours, Steven Chad Andrei M. Pandaan
